scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/copy-assets.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings scripts/write-service-version.mjs
scripts.test: for dir in tests/unit tests/integration; do set -- "$dir"/*.test.ts; test -f "$1" || { echo "No test files found in $dir" >&2; exit 1; }; done; tsx --test --test-timeout=60000 tests/unit/*.test.ts tests/integration/*.test.ts
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm test:e2e && pnpm --dir web build && git diff --check
